protocol.scope: one actual phone collection with all sixteen unchanged read-only probes, same source-independent output verifier
protocol.candidate_revision_kind: sha256 of exact executed collector bytes
protocol.mount_contract: Complete parsed inventory is retained; the root-mount record must match. Live descendant mounts may change and are not stale gold labels.
limitations: Single host/workflow pilot; not a population-tail or fleet-wide causal estimate.
Collection validity does not assert complete host inventory, convergence, model readiness or fleet planning.
Human code/research effort and local energy are unmeasured; no monetary ROI claim.
A shared measured protocol-preparation cost is charged once to each standalone counterfactual arm.

timing_scope: Fresh local CLI request through the prospective bounded stable-fact verifier. This is not whole-assistant/tool/UI time, full machine truth, independent custody or sustained throughput.
lineage: All v1/v2/v3 attempts are one related collection workflow family, not three independent efficacy samples.
limits: One host/work item per arm; quantiles are singleton order statistics.
The explicit package set, stable CPU facts, root mount and complete parsed16probe output are the prespecified useful facts; transient child mounts are observations, not frozen labels.
First-use research, rejected experiments, human implementation effort, local energy and full optimization cost are not erased or priced as zero.
The fixed-implementation invocation performs no search/training; its observed zero optimization-in-invocation is not zero development cost.
No runtime adoption or population-causal conclusion follows.
